description: Get the latest finalized blockhash. Use it when building a transaction you will sign and send yourself; a transaction is only valid with a recent blockhash. Returns {network, blockhash, timestamp}. Cost: 1 credit (0.0022 SOL) after the 27-call trial. Example: {"network":"mainnet-beta"}

network.description: Cluster to query: "mainnet-beta" (real funds; the default) or "devnet" (test network). Optional.

name: get_solana_blockhash
